payouts.title: Payouts
payouts.subtitle: View the balance and bank payouts for your connected Stripe account.
payouts.setupBody: Connect your payout account and complete identity verification with Stripe.
payouts.schedule: Payout timing depends on your Stripe account settings and bank processing.
payouts.kyc_submitted: KYC submitted. Stripe is reviewing — usually clears within a few minutes.
payouts.kyc_incomplete: Onboarding started but not completed. Click "Continue onboarding" to finish.
payouts.needs_onboarding: Set up payouts before you can sell books.
payouts.onboarding_failed: Something went wrong with onboarding. Try again.
payouts.balanceScope: These amounts are funds already in your connected Stripe account. Royalty earnings that have not been allocated and transferred to this account are not included.
payouts.historyScope: The latest 100 bank payouts from your connected Stripe account, including pending and failed payouts. Dates are shown in UTC. The CSV covers the same latest 100 payouts.
payouts.historyEmpty: No bank payouts have been recorded for this account yet.
payouts.reportError: We could not download your payout report. Please try again.
payouts.reportSignedOut: Please sign in again to download your payout report.
payouts.reportStarted: Your payout CSV download has started.
payouts.moreHistory: Older payouts exist. This view and CSV cover only the latest 100; see Stripe for older history.
payouts.testMode: Stripe test mode — these balances and payouts are test data.
payouts.loadError: We could not load your payout information. Please try again.
